name: Fuyu no Sazanami
source:
...Someone dear to me has died.
Since then, I've stopped attending university, cut off all contact with others, and shut myself away in my room.
One day, guided by a magazine I happened to pick up, I set off alone to the Pacific Ocean in the dead of winter.

There, I encountered the ghost of a beautiful woman.
And a man who called himself Yomogi, who approached me with an oddly friendly demeanor.

Will these interactions, along with the gentle ripples of the winter sea, help me break free from my stagnant time?

--
translation:
……我亲爱的人死了。
从那时起，我就不再上大学了，断绝了与他人的一切联系，把自己关在房间里。
有一天，我在偶然捡到的一本杂志的指引下，独自出发，在隆冬时节前往太平洋。

在那里，我遇到了一位美丽女子的鬼魂。
还有一个自称与木木的男人，他以一种奇怪的友好态度向我走来。

这些互动，连同冬日大海的温柔涟漪，能否帮助我摆脱停滞的时光？

--
